comparison_to_prior_banks: Any prior11/24 outcome or epoch26 10/24 uses different documents/models/context; historical only, never paired improvement evidence
exposure_retirement: Any selected source input projection retires all8fixeddocs as projectDEV forever, including failure:253→261exposed,24reserved unchanged,146→138unreserved,total423
gold_protocol: Auditor validates fixed ordered24inputs/rawcaseidentities and all72finite3way logits/probabilities, decisions, pair tokens and reader latencies, plus complete execution and owned-process closure, before first selected annotation choice access. Then join only24predetermined choices. No class-based redraw or candidate changes.
isolation: Complete public annotated JSON loaded in builder and scorer RAM; no annotation choices projected by builder. Logical field-access isolation only, never OS-enforced label isolation.
matched_controls: Same frozen classifier/tokenizer/softmax/context budget and source input; actual nativeRuVector/RRF/BGE ANN versus lexical Jaccard versus positional; exact literal premise, selected spans, UTF8 byte hashes, numerical-literal omission and unknown/overflow paths retained in raw

metrics.Brier: Mean sum of three class squared errors; range0..2
metrics.NLL: Mean -ln(max(p_gold,1e-12)); clipping count disclosed; reported probability vector not silently normalized
metrics.accuracy: Case count and every original class count/correct, full confusion and per-document outcomes
metrics.errors: All raw errors/attempts/counters retained. Partial/missing/invalid outputs have no complete-corpus metric or gold projection and remain failed.
metrics.latency: p50/p95 linear interpolation at(n−1)*p; reader forward distinct from retrieval/context/init and wholeworker
metrics.sampling: 8document groups×3correlated hypotheses; no IID24case confidence interval

model_eligibility: Separate exact-reader admission required before input/runtime launch; this protocol alone does not admit model acquisition, loading or execution
model_overlap: Exact head supervised-training/selection/calibration provenance reviewed separately. Foundation web text and fuzzy contract overlap remain unknown and disclosed; known head chronology exclusion is not foundation-text exclusion.
permanent_benchmark_gate: benchmark_accepted=false/champion_promoted=false/official_SOTA_established=false regardless descriptive DEV outcome. CONF=[]HOLD; absent exact full champion comparison no replacement or submission.
probability: Frozen uncalibrated unit-temperature softmax; native first-index argmax tie rule C,N,E; no fitting, threshold adjustment, logit remapping, classifier-head initialization or retraining
selection: Metadata-only once; never redraw or rebalance after source aliases, class, difficulty, length, runtime or performance findings
